snippet.title: Big Golden Rock - Pixel Incremental Clicker Idle Game | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Big Golden Rock on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4832030/Big_Golden_Rock/

Big Golden Rock is a pixel incremental clicker and idle strategy game about destroying a huge golden rock, collecting resources, and unlocking powerful upgrades.

It all starts with a single rock.

Gather gold, diamonds, stone, and metal. Hire shooters and archers, build stone towers and Tesla towers, launch rockets, summon UFOs, and push deeper into a growing upgrade tree. Every destroyed rock gives you more resources, more choices, and more ways to increase your damage and income.

Big Golden Rock combines active clicking, automatic resource gathering, long-term progression, prestige bonuses, and pixel-art incremental gameplay built for players who love idle games, clicker games, upgrade trees, and numbers going up.

Features:
- Pixel incremental clicker gameplay
- Active clicking and automatic resource generation
- Gold, diamonds, stone, and metal resources
- Large upgrade tree with multiple progression paths
- Shooters, archers, towers, rockets, lightning, and UFOs
- Prestige system with permanent bonuses
- Long-term idle progression and growing difficulty

If you enjoy incremental games like Cookie Clicker, Antimatter Dimensions, Clicker Heroes, NGU Idle, or other idle clicker games, add Big Golden Rock to your Steam wishlist.

#BigGoldenRock #IncrementalGame #IdleGame #ClickerGame #IndieGame
